description: EXPERIMENTAL FD-01: original fast swept flying-wing EPO pusher in the 0.78 m speed-wing class (FunJet class figures: 783 mm, 14.5 dm2, 875 g, 4S). Geometry/textbook tailless aerodynamics, estimated inventory, borrowed APC 7x6 propeller map, estimated electric drive on the finite 4S 2200 mAh class pack (pack_ecm); no landing gear (hand launch), tougher foam airframe. Not flight validated.
